meta.note: Single source of truth for clarifying-question options. The AI may only pick from these ids; schema.py rejects anything else. Alphabetical by label; hints shown in the UI when an option is clicked.

question: Which packaging do you see on the product?

options.label: Carton / Tetra Pak
options.hint: Drink cartons and Tetra Pak: empty, rinse, flatten - Tetra Pak slot at the re Kiosk.

options.label: Glass bottle or jar
options.hint: Glass bottles and jars: rinse, no need to remove labels. Metal lids go separately.

options.label: Metal can
options.hint: Aluminium or steel cans: rinse; flatten if the bin asks for it.

options.label: None of these
options.hint: Nothing above matches - the helper will say it cannot sort this item rather than guess.

options.label: Paper cup (coffee cup)
options.hint: Clean take-away paper cups go to the Tetra Pak slot; plastic lid and paper sleeve are separated.

options.label: Plastic bottle
options.hint: PET/HDPE drink bottles: empty, rinse, cap screwed back on.

options.label: Plastic or foam cup
options.hint: Plastic or foam cups, incl. cup-noodle pots: empty and rinse, plastic stream.
